🎬 Maudie (2016)

Maudie tells the inspiring true story of Maud Lewis, a Canadian folk artist whose extraordinary creativity and determination helped her overcome a lifetime of physical challenges, poverty, and social isolation. Living in rural Nova Scotia during the 1930s, Maud struggles with rheumatoid arthritis and a family that often underestimates her ability to live independently. Determined to build a life of her own, she accepts a housekeeping job with Everett Lewis, a rough and emotionally distant fish peddler who lives in a tiny house near the coast. Their relationship begins with tension and misunderstandings, but gradually develops into an unconventional romance built on companionship, loyalty, and shared experiences. Despite their difficult circumstances, Maud finds happiness through painting, transforming ordinary household objects and small canvases into colorful works of art inspired by the natural beauty surrounding her. As her distinctive paintings begin attracting attention, her talent slowly earns recognition beyond their isolated community. Meanwhile, Maud and Everett must navigate financial struggles, personal insecurities, and the challenges of maintaining their complicated relationship. Through quiet moments of tenderness, emotional hardship, and remarkable perseverance, the film reveals how artistic passion can bring meaning and beauty into even the simplest life. Combining heartfelt performances, beautiful scenery, and deeply moving storytelling, Maudie explores love, resilience, creativity, independence, acceptance, and the extraordinary power of finding joy despite adversity.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 55m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Aisling Walsh
